title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function here is the difference between the actual value and the predicted value from the model. Think about how this difference can be expressed in terms of the model parameters.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to Theta $$1$$
text: To find the gradient, you need to take the partial derivative of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_1$$. Consider how the term involving $$\theta_1$$ in the model affects the loss.
